segments.text: We first tried Data analytics dashboard in 207. At the time, market pressure mattered because customers were asking for digital receipts.
The biggest issue was Power outages. Without steady power in Enugu, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Data analytics dashboard—we saw Sales increase within 3 months.
Policy-wise, Import duty waivers shaped our move. We adjusted by Staff training.
Data helped; even a moving-average model gave us clearer demand patterns during New Year.
